m265: What is Baby Phone: Animal Sounds?
m266: Baby Phone: Animal Sounds is a playful, ad-free pretend phone app for young children. Children choose an animal, make a pretend call and listen to its sounds. The animal's name appears on the screen but is not spoken aloud.
m267: Can children make real phone calls?
m268: No. All calls are part of pretend play within the app. Baby Phone does not call real phone numbers or connect children with other people.
m270: Which languages are available for animal names?
m271: Does Baby Phone have ads or a subscription?
m272: No. Baby Phone has no ads or subscriptions. Additional animal packs are available as optional one-time in-app purchases.
m273: Where can I download Baby Phone?
m274: Baby Phone: Animal Sounds is currently available on Google Play for Android. The iPhone (iOS) version is coming soon. To download the app, use the official Google Play link on this page.
m275: Do Mini Dodo apps have ads?
m276: No. We create every Mini Dodo app without ads so children can explore, learn and have fun without advertising interruptions.
m278: Parental Gate is an additional parental check we use in all Mini Dodo apps. It helps separate children's play from settings and purchase options intended for adults. The verification method may differ from one app to another.
m279: How does Mini Dodo approach children's privacy?
m280: Children's privacy is an important part of our approach to developing apps. We aim to limit data use to what each app needs and clearly explain to parents how that data is handled.
m281: Where can I find privacy information for a particular app?
m282: Privacy information is available in the privacy policy. There, we explain what data each app uses, for what purpose and what options parents have. The details may differ between apps.
m283: How do purchases work in Mini Dodo apps?
m284: Some apps may offer optional additional content. For each app, we clearly explain what is included and which extra purchases are available. Purchases are confirmed through the app store, and a parental check separates access to purchasing areas from children's play.
m285: Do safeguards differ between Mini Dodo apps?
m286: Our core principles stay the same: ad-free play, care for privacy and parental safeguards. Individual features and the way safeguards are implemented may differ by app. We explain the important details for each app.
